scope: Declarative mapping of existing Atlas owners. Does not activate new public objects or change existing consumer behavior.

identity.objectId: Existing family-specific ID; do not allocate a second ID
identity.nodeCode: Resolve only an existing canonical node binding; absence => WITHHELD, never infer from topic.

fields.title: Existing bilingual title/titleZh/titleEn
fields.definition: Existing reviewed definition/summary; absent => WITHHELD, never compose a canonical definition
fields.relationships: Existing relatedCases/windows/snapshots/dossiers only; links do not establish causation
fields.lastReviewedAt: Existing lastReviewedAt; absent => null, no fabricated review date
fields.version: Existing version or owning registry version
fields.unknownState: Retain field-scoped unknowns; missing detailed evidence remains unresolved
fields.authorityOwner: Existing family owner; article and figure never replace it
fields.authorityBoundary: Historical knowledge and structured readout only, no live CIV state or operational fact
fields.runtimeEligibility: REFERENCE_ONLY until existing Runtime owner independently admits a candidate
fields.projectionState: WITHHELD until canonical binding + definition + provenance + Human Review

bookVIIFields.rule: Do not translate Book VI dataClass or signal into Book VII epistemic verdict. Existing KAP must evaluate it.

nativeClassPolicy.STRUCTURAL_KNOWLEDGE: Existing Book VI native label; universal dataClass STRUCTURED_KNOWLEDGE only with native label retained
nativeClassPolicy.OBSERVED_SIGNAL: Existing native signal label, never equated with evidence or assigned a Book VII state
nativeClassPolicy.otherDataClasses: Reuse accepted universal class where exact identity holds; unsupported values withheld

admissionRequirements: existing Runtime admission for operational eligibility
